No RootView, BoardMapView, model geometry, canonical package, test or renderer production fix.
bodyGate: Both model views evaluate a launch-constant condition before evaluating handContent, accessing sceneStorage.scene, constructing GeometryReader/RealityView, or constructing gestures. OFF returns flexible Color.clear with hit testing and accessibility disabled. The outer cue card, text and caller modifiers are untouched. lifetimeProof.openRecord: Version 1, process ID, strict suppression value and all four zero counters. Any constructor before first board observation initializes the same recorder and immediately records its constructor count.
lifetimeProof.everyExistingRecord: Cumulative counters included without adding observers, periodic work or SwiftUI state writes.
lifetimeProof.offRequired: Fresh process, exact binary/source parity and launch flags, complete contiguous stream beginning recorder-open, no recorder errors/event limit, final existing completion marker after last screenshot, all four counts remain zero and no hand-lifecycle records. Sparse public host census additionally verifies actual board host/layout; it is not used to infer absence of past hand construction.
lifetimeProof.onRequired: Positive hand constructor and make observations establish instrumentation reaches actual used paths. It need not exercise both single/pair paths; unused paths remain statically instrumented.
lifetimeProof.coverageLimit: Counters prove these two app hand scene/host entry points through the final retained marker, not all framework GPU activity or all future process lifetime. They do not assert deallocation or that a retained object is active.

layoutGate: Compare actual board viewport/frame, root/camera transforms, surrounding cue/text placement and screenshot phase offsets across same-binary arms. Flexible clear is intended to preserve proposed size, but matching actual layout must be measured by existing sparse census and whole-image inspection. Do not add compensating frames to force equality.
limitations: Constructor default argument GripHandAsset.bundled and stored entity initializers evaluate before constructor-body logging. Normal OFF body gate prevents the lazy scene constructor invocation; any externally injected scene has already been created and must appear in lifetime counts. Do not claim suppression of arbitrary direct scene construction elsewhere.
This diagnostic suppresses both scene creation and hand rendering together; an outcome cannot distinguish their mechanisms.
Sparse synchronous file writes can perturb timing. ON and OFF share instrumentation; fresh ON failure is a required gate, not historical evidence from another binary.
